title: Count Passing Marks
description: Write a function `count_passes(marks, threshold=40)` that counts how many student marks meet or exceed the passing threshold. Marks equal to the threshold count as passing. Return 0 if the list is empty.

hidden_tests.kind: a mark exactly on the pass boundary

hints: Threshold evaluations often require careful inspection of strict versus inclusive comparison operators.
Look at your relational operator inside the loop condition: are you checking > or >=?
A mark equal to 40 is a passing score. Using strictly greater than excludes students on the exact cutoff.
Change '>' to '>=' to include marks that exactly reach the passing threshold.
Loop over each mark, initialize a counter at 0, and increment by 1 when mark >= threshold.
